prompt:
主題：
赤レースのウインク

主体：
画面左から中央、暖かな夜のリビングで若い女性がラグへ深くしゃがみ、白いスマートフォンでセルフィーを撮る。赤いフリルレースのミニドレス、黒い細ヒール、片目のウインクが主役。

人物・表情：
丸みのある細い顔、小さな顎、開いた右目は明るい茶色、細い眉、すっきりした鼻筋、舌先がわずかに見える艶のある桃色の唇。顔を右へ傾け、左目を閉じてウインクし、スマートフォンへ茶目っ気のある視線を送る。ライトブラウンの長い波打つ髪は薄い前髪があり、両肩へ流れ、後頭部を大きな黒いリボンで半分結ぶ。

服装・ポーズ：
鮮やかな赤の細肩紐ミニドレスは肩のリボン結び、胸元の細いリボン、段状に重なる透けたフリルとレース、非対称な短い裾がある。黒い細いアンクルストラップのオープントゥヒールを履く。両膝を揃えて深くしゃがみ、左肘を左膝へ置いて左頬を手に預け、右腕を前へ伸ばしてスマートフォンを持つ。

背景・光：
画面左に白いフロアランプと生成りのソファ、中央に淡色の壁とカーテン、画面右に黒い丸卓、灯したキャンドル、白い小花、窓外の都市灯、下部に毛足の長い生成りラグがある。画面左のランプと右のキャンドルによる柔らかな暖色光が顔、赤レース、膝、足元を包む。

構図・カメラ：
3:4の縦構図、床に近い正面カメラで頭頂から両足先まで全身を収める。人物を左半分へ大きく置き、曲げた両膝を中央下、スマートフォンを胸前、丸卓を右側へ配置。靴まで収め、顔とスマートフォンにピント、夜景と室内奥は柔らかくぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
フォトリアルな実写写真。自然な肌、長い髪、透ける赤レース、細かなフリル、黒い革ヒール、ラグとキャンドル光を高精細にし、赤、黒、琥珀色の親密な夜色。

ネガティブ：
片目ウインクと深いしゃがみ変更；赤レース省略

promptTranslations.en:
Subject:
Red Lace Wink

Main Subject:
From the left to the center of the frame, in a warm evening living room, a young woman crouches deeply on a rug, taking a selfie with a white smartphone. A red ruffled lace mini dress, black slender heels, and a one-eyed wink are the centerpieces.

Person / Expression:
A slender face with rounded contours, small chin, open right eye in light brown, thin eyebrows, clean bridge of the nose, and glossy pink lips with the tip of her tongue slightly visible. Head tilted to the right, left eye closed in a wink, directing a playful gaze at the smartphone. Long, wavy light brown hair with thin bangs flowing over both shoulders, tied in a half-up style at the back of the head with a large black ribbon.

Attire / Pose:
A vibrant red thin-strap mini dress featuring shoulder ribbon ties, a delicate ribbon at the chest, tiered sheer ruffles and lace, and an asymmetrical short hemline. Wearing black thin ankle-strap open-toe heels. Crouching deeply with knees kept together, resting her left elbow on her left knee to support her left cheek in her hand, while extending her right arm forward holding the smartphone.

Background / Lighting:
On the left of the frame are a white floor lamp and an off-white sofa, in the center are light-colored walls and curtains, and on the right are a black round table, lit candles, small white flowers, and city lights outside the window, with a high-pile off-white rug at the bottom. Soft, warm light from the lamp on the left and the candles on the right envelops her face, the red lace, knees, and feet.

Composition / Camera:
3:4 vertical composition, frontal camera close to the floor capturing the entire body from the top of the head to the tips of both feet. The figure is prominently placed in the left half, with bent knees in the lower center, the smartphone in front of the chest, and the round table arranged on the right. Framing includes the shoes, sharp focus on the face and smartphone, with a soft blur on the night view and the room interior's depth.

Texture / Style:
Photorealistic live-action photograph. High-definition natural skin, long hair, sheer red lace, intricate ruffles, black leather heels, rug, and candlelight, creating intimate nighttime tones of red, black, and amber.

Negative:
Altering the one-eyed wink and deep crouch; omitting red lace

summaryTranslations.en: A photo-style prompt of a woman wearing a red lace mini dress, crouching deeply on a living room rug, and taking a winking selfie with a smartphone.

translations.zh:
主题：红蕾丝眨眼
主体：在温暖的夜晚客厅中，年轻女性深蹲在地毯上，用白色手机自拍。红荷叶边蕾丝超短裙，黑色细高跟，单眼眨眼。
人物表情：微圆细瘦的脸、小下巴、亮褐色右眼、微露舌尖的粉唇。歪头左眼眨眼，调皮眼神。浅棕微卷长发配薄刘海与黑色大蝴蝶结半扎。
服饰动作：亮红细吊带蕾丝短裙，肩部系带，层叠透视荷叶边。黑色细系带露趾高跟鞋。并膝深蹲，左肘搭左膝托颊，右臂前伸持机自拍。
背景光影：左侧白色落地灯与米色沙发，中央淡色墙与窗帘，右侧黑色圆桌、烛光、小白花及窗外夜景，暖色柔光包裹全身。
构图镜头：3:4竖构图低机位正面全身，脸部和手机聚焦，背景虚化。
质感风格：真实写真风，高清细节，私密温暖夜晚氛围。
负面提示：改变单眼眨眼与深蹲姿势；省略红色蕾丝
translations.en:
Subject: Red lace wink
Main subject: Young woman deep squatting on a rug in a warm night living room, taking a selfie with a white smartphone, wearing a red ruffled lace mini dress and black stiletto heels.
Appearance: Soft delicate face, hazel right eye, winking left eye, slight tongue tip showing, light brown wavy hair tied half-up with a black ribbon.
Attire & Pose: Bright red lace spaghetti-strap mini dress, black ankle-strap heels. Deep squat, left elbow resting on knee supporting cheek, right arm holding phone.
Background & Lighting: Cozy living room with floor lamp, candle on marble side table, city lights outside, warm ambient glow.
Composition: 3:4 vertical shot, low angle, focused on subject and phone.
Style: Photorealistic photo, intimate night colors.
Negative: Changing wink or deep squat; omitting red lace
